1. **box2d GATE-A** — host natives = `bash scripts/s183_build_gdx_host.sh` (fetch-if-missing). GATE A substitutes them (bouncy byte-exact vs S183b pin).

4. **CHAR-typed integral args** — a `C` parameter arrives `DalvikType::CHAR`; any arm that requires `== INT32` and answers a default otherwise is a silent-wrong-law (lastIndexOf/indexOf delimiter fixed; AUDIT YOUR ARMS).
5. **ArrayDeque.descendingIterator** — reversed-snapshot iterator box in CollectionShadow (OnBackPressedDispatcher family).

## S186h — tibarj #170 probe chain: TWO new generic engine laws (HEAD 3c9d418f)

**Root chain (fresh store, real-dalvik, disasm-pinned):**
`FCV.<init>` (kept name, XML-referenced) → R8-renamed `FragmentManager.findFragmentById` (`Lb1/t0;.A`) → read `Lb0/k;.a` (fragment store) → NPE. F-NEW-188/188b are name-keyed and cannot fire on obfuscated androidx.

**Law 1 — ARITY LAW (overload matcher core):** `run_custom_view_constructor` supplies 3 args but the descriptor-less matcher picked the 3-param internal ctor `(Context, AttributeSet, FM)` (type-prefix + largest-bytecode) — the FM register read a stale heap oid. `[FCV-SEL]` diag proves the pick before/after. Exact-arity candidates now win (ART JVMS 5.4.5). After: 2-arg ctor picked.

**Law 2 — F-NEW-188c obfuscated-FM real-init:** resolve the REAL FM class structurally from FCV's internal-ctor signature (R8 cannot rename FCV or signatures), alias canonical+real singleton keys to ONE object id, run the real `<init>()V` once. A/B'd at the matcher level; generalization queued: the same real-init must cover the androidx construction chain (u1/a lifecycle-null, a/q FragmentHostCallback, g/l.<init>) — #170 now reaches the fragment state machine (`b1/d0.H` depth=5) but 12 uncaught remain, face still black. **No verdict upgrade (Rule 5).**

**ODR lesson recorded:** adding members to `DalvikExecutionEngine` across a partial rebuild = sizeof mismatch = segfault in `std::string::_M_assign` during APPLICATION_CREATE (dooz caught it). Law state now fn-local statics.

## 6 generic engine laws (root-cause-first, measured)

1. **S187A F-023 AUTHORITY LATCH** — the S186h exact-arity override clobbered the F-023
   exact-descriptor pick on R8 **covariant bridge pairs**: `next()Object` ↔ `next()Map$Entry`
   bridge→bridge recursion (RECURSION-LIMIT depth=2048) → `next()` answered null →
   `Map$Entry.getValue` NPE. Proof: `[OVERLOAD-PICK] want=next()Ljava/util/Map$Entry; exact_desc=hit
   picked next()Ljava/lang/Object; bc=5`. Fix: arity override applies only when no exact-descriptor
   hit (ART JVMS 5.4.5 — (name, descriptor) is the whole contract when known). Victims:
   LifecycleRegistry.forwardPass/sync (foehnix #126, aoc #132, gnubg #72) + AndroidComposeView
   chain (solitaire #43). **This law is corpus-wide** — every covariant-bridge overload was latent.
2. **S187B annotation DEFAULT law** — defaults ride a vis=2 `Ldalvik/annotation/AnnotationDefault;`
   CLASS annotation on the @interface ITSELF (raw-dex measured: PluginMethod/CapacitorPlugin carry
   class_ann set with an EMPTY method-annotation table). dex_parser now decodes the nested
   element/value pairs into `ClassInfo::annotation_defaults`; both annotation-proxy accessor laws
   answer the declared default (string/bool/int/enum). Victims: capacitor JSExport
   `generateMethodJS` String.equals(null) — blichess #49, blidraughts #74.
3. **S187C `PackageManager.getResourcesForApplication`** → the app Resources singleton (AOSP:
   never null for a known package). Victim: firestrike #71 (appcompat `f.f` pc=68
   `.getConfiguration()` on null → attachBaseContext2 app-boundary death).
4. **S187D `Context.NSD_SERVICE`** — the AOSP service string is `"servicediscovery"`; the table only
   had the `"nsd"` shorthand → null → Kotlin `as NsdManager` cast NPE killed the compose root.
   Victim: guandan #41 → **A_RICH flip**.
5. **S187E Executors family** — `Executors.newXxx*` factory laws (never null, OpenJDK contract;
   scheduled family → ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor, else ThreadPoolExecutor) + engine-minted-executor
   companion (execute/submit inline DEX run via try_recursive_invoke; schedule → pending Future;
   shutdown family) + `Class.forName` allowlist += `android.graphics.Insets` (support-v7 Family-3,
   the class exists on every device ≥ API 29). Victim: bim.app #44 (Kotlin non-null executor field).
6. **S187F `Context.getColorStateList`** (API 23+ law) — F-NEW-383 ARSC resolution for the
   Context family; RECORDED DEVIATION: unresolvable ids answer deterministic single-spec BLACK with a
   loud `[S187F]` row (on device the merged support-design color always resolves — null was an engine
   artifact). Victim: de.tobiasbielefeld.solitaire #38 (`NavigationView.c` getDefaultColor NPE).

## S200 P0 TARGET A — microtimer: **declared core feature 100% VERIFIED end-to-end** (first complete real application)

This is the S200 completion-rule claim, worded per mission law: **100% of declared core feature verified; optional features remain.**

**Identity.** APK `dubrowgn.microtimer_8.apk` (sha16 `79c6f730f64886e7`). Binary **`96329a7ad50819d0`** (HEAD `3da4f796`, built `make -j2`) — the same binary for every claim below.

**Declared core feature (from upstream source, not invented):** keypad duration entry → label; START → Room/SQLite INSERT + `TimerControl` row added to `layoutAlarms`; Handler-tick countdown; per-row PAUSE/RESUME (button swap); per-row DELETE; cold-restart restore via `loadAlarms()`.

**Verified chain (real Dalvik bytecode, real views, real taps, real SQLite):**
1. **Launch + real UI** — keypad 1-9/00/0 rendered white-on-blue, input row + dividers; 25-node view tree exactly matching the layout.
2. **Input reaches the correct components** — F117-TAP trace: `'1'→obj134`, `'0'→obj147`, `START→obj148`, `PAUSE→obj264`, **`RESUME→obj270` (the swapped-in button — the tap hit the re-parented view)**, `DELETE→obj253`.
3. **State changes → next frame correct** — label region +11350 px after digit taps (`00:00:10` rendered); countdown churn 3537 px across frames; **pause freezes the label to 0 changed px**; resume restarts the churn; delete removes the row (final tree: row absent, input cleared).
4. **Persistence (SQLite, cross-process)** — cold restart with ZERO taps restores the row from the Room DB; direct `sqlite3` on the store DB: tables `alarm`/`sqlite_sequence`/`room_master_table`, row `(duration=10, remaining=10, id=1, expires_ms=12290)`; restored label **`00:00:07`** and ticking.
5. **3+1 clean independent runs equivalent** — identical tap-target signature `[134,147,148,264,270,253]`, identical transition booleans (tick✓ / pause-frozen✓ / resume✓ / row-removed✓), **0 uncaught exceptions in every run**.

**First divergence found → shared fix (F-NEW-621 device-clock law).** The acceptance harness was written and its probe run on the UNMODIFIED S199 canonical `97628b00d237f9eb` BEFORE any runtime edit. Probe result: cold restart restored the row but the label instantly read `00:00:00` while the DB said `remaining_dec6=10`. Root cause: `SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()` returned the in-process virtual clock (rewinds to 0 each run), but AOSP defines it as monotonic since device boot, shared by all processes — the persisted `expires_ms` landed in the "future" of the rewound clock → `ceil((expiresMs-nowMs)/1000) > totalSeconds` → Kotlin UInt wrap → `remaining.zero()`. Fix (shared, no app-specific path): device == data-root; boot base persisted at `<data-root>/data/system/device_clock`, read at run start, accumulated clock written at run end (monotone guard); offset applied ONLY at the SystemClock boundary (`HandlerShadow::device_now_ms()`), Looper scheduling untouched. Fresh store = fresh boot (base 0) → deterministic reruns unchanged.
